title: Instagram's head says engagement falls by half without the algorithm
summary: Adam Mosseri, head of Instagram, revealed that user engagement drops by approximately 50% when users opt out of the algorithmic feed, demonstrating the critical role algorithms play in content curation and user retention on social media platforms.
problem_solved: This article explains why social media platforms rely heavily on algorithmic curation and quantifies the impact of removing algorithmic control from user feeds.
why_valuable: It provides empirical evidence (50% engagement drop) that algorithmic curation is essential for modern social media platforms to maintain user engagement, offering valuable insight for product decisions and policy discussions about algorithmic opt-outs.
